headwords.text:
To see a volcano in your dreams, signifies that you will be in violent disputes, which threaten your reputation as a fair dealing and honest citizen.

For a young woman, it means that her selfishness and greed will lead her into intricate adventures.

To dream of vomiting, is a sign that you will be afflicted with a malady which will threaten invalidism, or you will be connected with a racy scandal.

To see others vomiting, denotes that you will be made aware of the false pretenses of persons who are trying to engage your aid.

For a woman to dream that she vomits a chicken, and it hops off, denotes she will be disappointed in some pleasure by the illness of some relative. Unfavorable business and discontent are also predicted.

If it is blood you vomit, you will find illness a hurried and unexpected visitor.  You will be cast down with gloomy forebodings, and children and domesticity in general will ally to work you discomfort.
headwords.note: 기존 vomiting(구토) 상징에 문맥 넷을 붙였다 — 이미 term_ko가 같아 새 상징을 세우지 않았다

headwords.text:
If you dream of casting a vote on any measure, you will be engulfed in a commotion which will affect your community.

To vote fraudulently, foretells that your dishonesty will overcome your better inclinations.
headwords.note: 기존 election(투표) 상징에 문맥 둘을 붙였다 — 이미 영어 별칭으로 "voting"을 쥐고 있었다

headwords.text:
To dream of vouchers, foretells that patient toil will defeat idle scheming to arrest fortune from you.

To sign one, denotes that you have the aid and confidence of those around you, despite the evil workings of enemies.

To lose one, signifies that you will have a struggle for your rights with relatives.
headwords.note: 기존 document(문서) 상징에 문맥 셋을 붙였다 — 이미 한국어 별칭으로 "증서"(voucher와 같은 뜻)를 쥐고 있었다

headwords.text:
To dream that you are making or listening to vows, foretells complaint will be made against you of unfaithfulness in business, or some love contract. To take the vows of a church, denotes you will bear yourself with unswerving integrity through some difficulty.

To break or ignore a vow, foretells disastrous consequences will attend your dealings.
headwords.note: 기존 oath(맹세) 상징에 문맥 셋을 붙였다 — 이미 term_ko가 같아 새 상징을 세우지 않았다

headwords.text:
To make a voyage in your dreams, foretells that you will receive some inheritance besides that which your labors win for you.

A disastrous voyage brings incompetence, and false loves.
headwords.note: 기존 long-journey(먼 길 떠남) 상징에 문맥 둘을 붙였다 — 이미 영어 별칭으로 "voyage"를 쥐고 있었다. 한국어 별칭에 "항해"류가 없어 새로 추가

headwords.text:
To dream of vultures, signifies that some scheming person is bent on injuring you, and will not succeed unless you see the vulture wounded, or dead.

For a woman to dream of a vulture, signifies that she will be overwhelmed with slander and gossip.
headwords.note: 새 상징 vultures(대머리수리) — 기존 eagle(독수리)과 다른 낱말을 골랐다(대머리수리가 정확한 콘돌·독수리 구분이며, "독수리"를 그대로 쓰면 eagle과 그대로 겹친다). 첫 문장은 조건절(다치거나 죽은 경우 실패)이 있어 둘로 나눔. 이것으로 밀러 원문 V 항목이 전부 끝난다 — 다음은 W(Wading)로 넘어간다
